TAO México

TAO México is a Riviera Maya-born developer of residential communities, with completed and ongoing projects in Tulum, Akumal and Puerto Aventuras and newer work in Puerto Vallarta and Los Cabos.

About TAO México

TAO México describes itself as an ecosystem of specialised companies working together on residential development: alongside the TAO development company sit businesses dedicated to design and materials innovation, construction, legal and permitting work, capital structuring and hospitality operations. Its first project in the region dates from 2013, and the company reports more than 19 years of experience and over 23 residential communities developed.

In Tulum, TAO completed TAO Tulum in Aldea Zamá, an eight-building residential community delivered between 2019 and 2022, and is building Edena Tulum, a private jungle community of homes and condominiums with 157 units. Its Riviera Maya portfolio also includes the TAO Community, Santamar and Sek developments in Akumal and TAO Náutico in Puerto Aventuras, while recent projects have taken the company to Puerto Vallarta and Los Cabos.

Key areas of activity

  • Residential communities in the Riviera Maya
  • Jungle and nature-integrated living
  • Condominiums, homes and residential lots
  • Integrated design, construction and property management
  • Pacific coast expansion (Puerto Vallarta, Los Cabos)
